Remark
[flatness and two-parameter parallel transport]

Source: petersen:page-0283 ↗ def:pet-ch6-parallel-field 1. ch6:6.7.5Let $c(s,t):[0,1]^2\to (M,g)$ satisfy $R(\partial c/\partial s,\partial c/\partial t)=0$. Show that for each $v\in T_{c(0,0)}M$ there is a parallel field $V:[0,1]^2\to TM$ along $c$ (i.e. $\partial V/\partial s=\partial V/\partial t=0$ everywhere) with $V(0,0)=v$.
